### Borea v0.4.0-dev.1: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.4.0 before it is released.
It is not for users. For normal use, stay on v0.3.2.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Pins: pin a mod from its "..." menu, then run "Update all". The pinned mod should stay, and the other mods should update. When a pin keeps another mod from its newest release, that row should say which pin holds it back.
- Modpacks: detach a mod of a pack from its "..." menu, update the pack, and attach the mod again. The pack update should leave the detached mod alone and name it.
- Descriptions: open mod pages with long descriptions and release notes. Links, tables, lists and code should look as the author wrote them, and a drag should select across all of it.
- The Content tab: mods you installed by hand should show in "Not managed by Borea", and "Manage with Borea" should take one over.
- Pins and detached mods are new in the record of an instance. An older Borea drops them when it saves such an instance, so test them in an instance you do not open with v0.3.x again.

#### New since v0.3.2

- Descriptions and release notes show links, tables, dividers, nested lists and code as the author wrote them, and a drag selects text across all of it.
- Pin a mod at its version, and see which pin holds back the update of another mod.
- Detach a mod from its modpack and attach it again.
- The "Manual installs" tab is gone; mods that Borea did not install show on the Content tab.
- The "..." menu of a mod or pack page has "Copy share link" and "Report".
- The License filter of Discover takes more than one license.
- Mod authors: the listing editor previews the description while you type.
- The command line has `borea pin`, `borea unpin`, `borea pack detach` and `borea pack attach`.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.4.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
